description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520001 and other title settlements
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in the Homagama area. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
